comment: PT Part 5: riders (modifiers from the user's Arcanist homebrew). mp raises the card's MP cost; scraps is the generic Scrap cost of the first rider on a card.

riders.name: Push/Pull
riders.text: Move the target 1 tile away from you.

riders.name: Daze
riders.text: Target loses its Quick and has -20% hit chance next turn.

riders.name: Lingering
riders.text: Target takes 30% of the hit again at the start of its next turn.

riders.name: Widen
riders.text: The area grows one step (plus becomes 3x3, a Line gets +2).

riders.name: Twin
riders.text: Single target only: also hits a second target within 2 tiles of the first.

riders.name: Extended
riders.text: Lasting effects (burn, auras, constructs, glyphs) last 1 round longer.
